description: List or search emails in a mailbox, with metadata and optional previews. Filter with query, which takes typed search such as from:ann@example.com is:unread after:2026-01-01, and use folder for custom folders and labels. Paginate with pageToken. Use get_email for full bodies.

accountId.description: Account to operate on. Optional when exactly one account is connected.

folder.description: Folder role (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, spam, starred, archive, all) or a label/folder name. Use all or omit this field to search all mail except Spam and Trash. An IMAP server's \All mailbox may use different rules.

includeSearchContext.description: Include a match-centered body excerpt; requires search words in query

query.description: Typed search. Plain words search the message text; quote a phrase or a value that has spaces. Filters: from:, to:, subject:, in:inbox|sent|drafts|archive|spam|trash|all, is:read, is:unread, is:starred, is:unstarred, has:attachment, -has:attachment, after:YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) and before:YYYY-MM-DD (exclusive), in UTC. Terms combine with AND; OR and parentheses are searched as text.

rawProviderQuery.description: Provider-native Gmail syntax or Outlook KQL for one compatible account

name: search_emails
title: List emails
